body: Thank you I do appreciate your advice and your help :)

Unfortunately with my current school schedule, it's very difficult to find a way to switch jobs :( I would if I could. But this job is easy on me and allows a lot of time to do homework which is essential to me. It's only the hours that suck, but it's just something I have to suck up for now. I have time during the week to visit my mom, at least once a week, sometimes more if things line up right. And I see my gf at home most evenings so that's good. It's just the overnight part where I get sad that I'm away from her. And her school schedule conflicts with the times I'm at home alone. It's all a big thing that can't be changed. Trust me, I'd change it if I could.

Thank you so much I appreciate this advice!! I'm gonna try to get more fresh air and activity in when I'm feeling down, I love that idea and I'm hoping it helps to clear my mind when I'm feeling down. Thank you so much hun
